currentImplementation.denominatorSource: sum BIDataPoint.metrics.paidBuyers over the same base platform/store/date points

requestedMetric.actualFormula: brand keyword paid buyers / total search-keyword paid buyers

formulaDifference: The legacy denominator is all paid buyers from BI product metrics; the requested denominator is paid buyers represented in total search-keyword data.
